changedFunctions.EP_SLM_DPS: LAMBDA(sm_damage, sl_damage, sm_cooldown, sm_heat, sm_aoe, tactical_barrage, has_aoe_card, aoe_card_level, sm_heat * sm_aoe * IF(tactical_barrage, 2, 1) * sm_damage * sl_damage / sm_cooldown * EPD_AOE_CARD_BOOST(has_aoe_card, aoe_card_level))
changedFunctions.EP_SM_DPS: LAMBDA(sm_damage, sm_quant, sm_cooldown, sm_coverfire, sm_heat, sm_aoe, tactical_barrage, has_aoe_card, aoe_card_level, sm_heat * sm_aoe * IF(tactical_barrage, 2, 1) * (sm_damage * sm_quant / sm_cooldown + sm_coverfire) * EPD_AOE_CARD_BOOST(has_aoe_card, aoe_card_level))
changedFunctions.EPC_GTB:
LAMBDA(stone_lvl, lab_lvl, has_perk, stone_sac, lab_sac, prim_sub, ass_sub, vault, LET(
  STONE, 5+0.8*stone_lvl,
  LAB, 0.15*lab_lvl,
  PERK, IF(has_perk, 1.5, 1),
  SAC, (1+stone_sac+lab_sac)*0.01,
  SUBSTAT, prim_sub+ass_sub*SAC,
  VAULTP, 1+vault,

(STONE+LAB)*PERK+SUBSTAT*VAULTP))
changedFunctions.EPD_SM_HEATUP:
LAMBDA(missile_amp, tactical_barrage, hit_on_same_target, EP_UW_HEATUP(
  1 + (1.5 * missile_amp * IF(tactical_barrage, 2, 1)),
  MAX(1, hit_on_same_target)
))
